}

html {
	box-sizing: border-box;
	height: 100%;
	font-size: 1rem;
	font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,Segoe UI,Roboto,Oxygen,Ubuntu,Cantarell,Droid Sans,Helvetica Neue,sans-serif;
	line-height: 1.5;
	color: var(--text);
}

body {
	margin: 0;
	padding: 0;
	overflow-x: hidden;
}

main {
	margin: 1rem;
	font-size: 1.25em;
	background-color: var(--background);
	background-image: url(images/background-tile-dark.svg);
	background-size: 18px;
}

@media(max-width: 37.5em) {
	.mistral main {
		margin: 0;
	}
}

.tetris main {
	background-image: url(images/background-tile-tetris.svg);
	background-size: 80px;
}

.linedots main {
	background-image: url(images/background-tile-linedots-dark.svg);
	background-size: 21px;
}

.circles main {
	background-image: url(images/background-tile-dark-circles.svg);
	background-size: 24px;
}

* {
	box-sizing: border-box;
}

:not(.home)>main {
	min-height: calc(100vh - 7.125rem);
}

img {
	max-width: 100%;
}

h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 {
	font-family: Georgia;
	font-weight: lighter;
	line-height: 1.2;
}

h1,
h2.entry-title {
	margin-bottom: 0.25em;
	color: var(--headline);
	font-size: 1.626em;
}

h2 {
	font-size: 1.35em;
}

@media(min-width: 37.5em) {
	h1,
	h2.entry-title {
		font-size: 2em;
		margin-bottom: 0.25em;
	}

	h2 {
		font-size: 1.75em;
	}
}

article.h-entry {
	margin-top: 3.5rem;
}

@media (min-width: 37.5em) {
	article.h-entry {
		margin-top: 5rem;
	}
}

.entry-title img {
	max-width: 1.5rem;
}

h3 {
	font-size: 1.5em;
	margin-bottom: 0.75em;
}

body:not(.mistral) figure img {
	border-radius: 0.3rem;
}

figure {
	margin: 0;
}

	padding-top: 0.25rem;
	padding-right: 1rem;
	padding-bottom: 0.25rem;
	padding-left: 1rem;
	color: var(--primary);
	background-color: var(--white);
	border: thin solid var(--primary);
	border-radius: 0.2rem;
}

.section-navigation li a:hover {
	color: var(--white);
	background-color: var(--secondary-trans);
}

.section-navigation li.active a {
	color: var(--white);
	background-color: var(--primary);
	border: thin solid var(--primary);
	border-radius: 0.2rem;
}



.gallery {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
	grid-gap: 0.5rem;
}

@media(min-width: 37.5em) {
	.gallery {
		grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;
		grid-gap: 1rem;
	}
}

.gallery-item {
	display: block;
}

.gallery-item img {
	display: block;
}

.mistral-gallery-item {
	list-style: none;
	margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.mistral-gallery-item figure {
	position: relative;
	margin: 0;
	padding: 0;
	border-top: none;
	width: fit-content;
	margin: 0 auto;
	overflow: hidden;
}

.mistral-gallery-item img {
	display: block;
}

.mistral-gallery-item figcaption {
	position: absolute;
	top: 0;
	padding: 0.25rem;
	background-color: var(--white);
	z-index: 1;
}

.lazyimage {
	filter: blur(40px);
}



.webmentions-wrapper label.icon--comment {
	padding-left: 1.8rem;
	font-weight: bold;
	background: url(/assets/css/images/icon-comment.svg) 0 50% no-repeat;
	background-size: 1.3rem;
	cursor: pointer;
}

.webmentions-wrapper label[aria-controls]:hover,
.webmentions-wrapper label[aria-controls]:focus,
input[type="checkbox"]:focus + label[aria-controls] {
	border-bottom: 0.1rem solid var(--accent);
  background-color: var(--white);
}

.commentions-form-wrapper {
	margin-top: 0.5rem;
	height: 0;
	overflow: hidden;
}

input:not(:checked) + label + .commentions-form-wrapper {
	display: none
}

input:checked + label + .commentions-form-wrapper {
	display: block;
	height: auto;
}

input:not(:checked) + label + .commentions-form-wrapper .commentions-form-wrapper-inner {
	opacity: 0.001;
}

input:checked + label + .commentions-form-wrapper .commentions-form-wrapper-inner {
	opacity: 1;
	transition: opacity 125ms ease-in;
	transition-delay: 1s;
}

/* ============================================= */

.commentions-form {
	padding: 1.25rem;
	border-radius: .2rem;
	background-color: var(--primary-trans);
}

.commentions-form-honeypot {
	display: none;
}

.commentions-form form:first-of-type h3:first-of-type {
	margin: 0;
}

.commentions-form label {
	font-size: 0.825rem;
}

.commentions-form input {
	width: 100%;
	padding: 0.25rem;
	font-size: 1rem;
	border: thin solid var(--primary);
	border-radius: 0.2rem;
	background-color: var(--text-negative);
}

.commentions-form label + input {
	margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
	padding: 0.5rem;
	color: var(--primary);
}

.commentions-form textarea {
	display: block;
	padding: 0.5rem;
	margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
	width: 100%;
	font-size: 1rem;
	color: var(--primary);
	border: thin solid var(--primary);
	border-radius: 0.2rem;
	background-color: var(--text-negative);
}

.commentions-list {
	margin-top: 4rem;
	font-size: 1rem;
}

.commentions-list ul {
	margin: 0;
	list-style: none;
}

.commentions-list li {
	padding: 1rem 0;
	border-bottom: thin solid var(--primary);
}

.commentions-list-type-comment h4 {
	margin-top: 0;
	font-size: 1rem;
	font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,Segoe UI,Roboto,Oxygen,Ubuntu,Cantarell,Droid Sans,Helvetica Neue,sans-serif;
	line-height: 1.5;
}

.commentions-list-type-comment {
	font-size: 1rem;
}

.commentions-list-message {
	margin-bottom: 1rem;
}



.mistral-headline {
	margin-top: 1rem;
	margin-right: 0;
	margin-left: 0;
	fill: var(--accent);
}

@media(min-width: 45em) {
	.mistral-headline {
		fill: #8d6d98;
	}
}

@media(min-width: 65em) {
	.mistral-headline {
		margin-right: -3rem;
		margin-left: -3rem;
		fill: #79c9d5;
	}
}

.mistral-gallery {
	margin-left: 0;
}

.infobox-mistral {
	padding: 0.5rem 1.5rem;
	font-size: 1rem;
	border-radius: 0.3rem;
	background-color: #79c9d5;
}

@media(min-width: 45em) {
	.infobox-mistral {
		width: 80%;
		margin: 0 auto;
	}
}

      <span class="p-name">
       Respecting Users
      </span>
      <a class="u-url">
       <img alt="Bookmark" src="rick.jpg">
      </a>
     </h1>
     <p class="post-info">
      published on
      <time class="published dt-published" datetime="2018-02-07 00:00:00">
       07.02.2018
      </time>
     </p>
     <div class="e-content">
      <div class="intro">
       <p>
        Reading “Respect always comes first” about applying a focus on security and ethics when designing experiences, makes me happy. It’s great to see that more people think about things like this and care about the same ideas.
       </p>
      </div>
      <p>
       I always liked the idea of blog-post-replies, hence this post in reply to
       <a>
        Vitaly’s article
       </a>
       . (We should do these things more often again ;))
      </p>
      <p>
       I feel the same way as many people do. You do something and you are not sure if you are doing the right thing.
      </p>
      <p>
       Reading “
       <a>
        Respect always comes first
       </a>
       ” about applying a focus on security and ethics when designing experiences, makes me happy.
       <br>
       Doing things in a better, more respective way and putting our users interests first can never be wrong and that’s why we follow in this approach with
       <a>
        Colloq
       </a>
       , too.
      </p>
      <p>
       From the article:
      </p>
      <blockquote>
       <p>
        Now, what if we tried something else? Here’s a start-up idea: If you want to “disrupt” anything, bring the focus to privacy, inclusivity, and ethics of your product.
       </p>
      </blockquote>
      <blockquote>
       <p>
        But Where Would We Even Start?
       </p>
      </blockquote>
      <h2>
       Everyone wants to create better experiences, but what are you willing to do for it?
      </h2>
      <p>
       First of all, you’ll have to be in the boat to want to improve something.
       <em>
        really
       </em>
       need to. This is not quite the current trend, since I see many projects deciding to throw everything on it to then later remove things to improve and optimise.
      </p>
      <p>
       <strong>
        Less data:
       </strong>
       Most projects start collecting countless amounts of data from the get go.
      </p>
      <p>
       <strong>
        Less tracking and better privacy:
       </strong>
       Consider which third-party plugins or apps you need to use.
      </p>
      <p>
       <strong>
        Better security:
       </strong>
       What is it that you do to make sure your users and their data is safe?
       <a>
        freely available leaked password databases
       </a>
       and use it on your site. Do you think about
       <a>
        Cross-Site Request Forgery
       </a>
       ?
      </p>
      <p>
       These are only a few examples and there are many more ways to better respect your users and improve their experience. In turn these considerations can make your life as a developer or product owner more secure and less painful as well.
      </p>

       <a>
        https://foobartel.com/@/page/TQeJtAuzn3WqcheJ

      </p>
